marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Expenditure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology conglomerates reported a 35% year-over-year increase in capital expenditure dedicated to AI data centers and custom hardware in recent earnings disclosures.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high hardware capex provides direct revenue visibility for semiconductor suppliers and specialized equipment vendors, though short-term software monetization margins face elevated scrutiny.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Return on invested capital (ROIC) realization velocity and potential hardware supply chain bottlenecks.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Heavyweights & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: Southbound net inflows via Stock Connect surpassed HK$6.2 billion, concentrating purchases in platform economy leaders including Tencent and Meituan following active corporate share buybacks.
marketLayer.inference: Strong institutional buying from mainland funds serves as a liquidity buffer against broad foreign capital realignments, anchoring valuation multiples for the Hang Seng Tech Index.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Recovery momentum in domestic retail sales and upcoming quarterly earnings guidance.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Expectations & Yield Impact
marketLayer.fact: US macro inflation indicators cooled in line with consensus targets, keeping federal funds futures pricing at a high probability for a rate cut in the upcoming FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: Easing risk-free yields enhances valuation headroom for high-growth tech equities and improves interest-rate-sensitive assets in Hong Kong, including real estate investment trusts.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential post-election fiscal policy shifts and service-sector inflation stickiness.

marketLayer.title: China Real Estate & Financial Sector Risk Transmission
marketLayer.fact: Mainland financial regulators announced expanded credit backing for qualifying developers, leading to intraday gains among major HK-listed mainland banks and property counters.
marketLayer.inference: Direct liquidity support reduces systemic credit default risks for lending institutions, stabilizing non-performing loan (NPL) ratio expectations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Actual home buyer transaction volume recovery across Tier 1 and Tier 2 cities.
